Our foundation

Rooted in Andhra taste.
Grown in Vijayawada.

RR Durbar began with a family poultry business built around quality and hygiene. That care carried into RR Joints, and then into RR Durbar, where Andhra flavours are served in a royal setting.

Every plate still follows the same simple idea: honest food, made consistently, for the whole table.

Who we are

RR Durbar is a restaurant brand serving Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, from six outlets. This website is operated by RR Fresh Foods (RR Durbar), D.No 40-7-3, Near Jammichettu Centre, Moghalrajpuram, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh 520010. GSTIN 37AEQPP7583R1Z2.

This policy explains how we handle personal data in line with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and other applicable Indian law.

What we collect

Details you give us:

  • Name and phone number, and your email if you choose to share it.
  • Your pickup outlet and any note for the kitchen.
  • Messages you send through the contact form, and event details (date, guest count, venue) in catering enquiries.

Collected automatically: basic technical data such as browser, device and pages viewed, through cookies or similar tools.

We do not store card or UPI details on this website.

How we use your details

  • To confirm, prepare and hand over your pickup order.
  • To reply to enquiries and send catering proposals.
  • To contact you by phone or WhatsApp about your order or enquiry.
  • To keep the website working, safe and easy to use.
  • To meet legal and accounting requirements.
Our promise

We do not sell your personal data.

WhatsApp and phone

If you send an order or enquiry on WhatsApp, or call us, the details you share are used only to handle that request. Chats on WhatsApp are also covered by WhatsApp’s own terms and privacy policy.

Who we share it with

  • The outlet that prepares your order.
  • Service providers who help us run the website and send messages, and a payment provider if online payment is introduced.
  • Authorities, when the law requires it.

Swiggy, Zomato, Instagram and Google Maps are separate services with their own policies. Links to them, and content embedded from them, are covered by their terms.

Cookies and local storage

We use a small amount of cookies and browser storage so the site works properly, for example to keep dishes in your cart. If we add analytics, it will be used only to understand how the site is used and improve it.

How long we keep it

We keep order and enquiry details only for as long as needed for the purpose they were given, or as required for legal and accounting reasons. After that we delete or anonymise them.

Keeping it safe

We use reasonable safeguards to protect your data. No website or message service is completely secure, so please share only what is needed.

Your rights

Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 you may:

  • Ask what personal data we hold about you.
  • Ask us to correct or complete it.
  • Ask us to erase it, or withdraw your consent.
  • Raise a grievance about how your data is handled.

To use these rights, contact us using the details at the end of this page.

Children

This website is not meant for children under 18, and we do not knowingly collect their personal data. If you believe a child has sent us details, tell us and we will delete them.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top shows when it last changed.

Contact and grievances

Grievance officer: [Grievance officer name]

Email: orders@rrdurbar.com · Phone: +91 77020 77999 · WhatsApp

We aim to acknowledge requests within 3 working days.

Questions about your data?

Contact us and we aim to acknowledge your request within 3 working days.

What this website offers

The website shows our menu, outlets and awards, lets you send pickup order requests and catering enquiries, and links to ordering on Swiggy and Zomato.

Menu items, prices and availability can change. Photos are for illustration, so the dish you receive may look slightly different.

Pickup orders

An order you send through the website or on WhatsApp is a request until the outlet confirms it by WhatsApp or phone.

We may decline or adjust an order if an item is unavailable, the outlet is closed or busy, or the order cannot be prepared on time.

Orders placed on Swiggy or Zomato are governed by their terms, delivery and refund processes.

Prices and payment

Prices are in Indian rupees. Applicable taxes are charged as required by law.

Payment today

Online payment is not live yet. For now, you pay at the outlet when you collect your order. If online payment is introduced, these terms will be updated.

Collecting your order

Please collect your order soon after we tell you it is ready. Food is cooked fresh and tastes best when eaten promptly.

Allergens and dietary needs

Allergen notice

Our kitchens handle ingredients such as nuts, dairy, gluten, eggs and seafood, so we cannot guarantee any dish is free from allergens. Please tell the outlet about any allergy or dietary need before you order.

Catering enquiries

A catering enquiry is a request for a proposal, not a booking. A booking is confirmed only when we send you a written confirmation and you accept it, together with any advance stated in the proposal.

Using the website properly

Please do not misuse the website, send false orders, try to break or overload it, or copy its content automatically.

Our content

The RR Durbar name, logo, photos, text and design belong to RR Durbar or its licensors. Please do not reuse them without our written permission. Swiggy, Zomato and other brand names belong to their owners.

Links to other sites

We link to services we do not control, such as Swiggy, Zomato, Instagram and Google Maps. We are not responsible for their content or practices.

Our responsibility

We work to keep the website accurate and available, but it is provided “as is” and may sometimes be unavailable or contain errors.

To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss. Nothing in these terms limits any right you have under law that cannot be limited.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of India. Courts at Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh have jurisdiction over any dispute.

Changes to these terms

We may update these terms from time to time. Continuing to use the website after a change means you accept the updated terms.

Contact us

Call +91 77020 77999 or message us on WhatsApp. Our outlet addresses are on the Branches page.

Policies

Refund & cancellation

What happens if you need to cancel an order, if something is not right with your food, or if you change a catering booking.

Last updated: 12 October 2026Applies to rrdurbar.com
Cancel before cooking

You can cancel until the outlet starts preparing your food.

Nothing charged online

Where this applies

This policy covers pickup orders placed through rrdurbar.com or WhatsApp, and catering bookings.

Orders placed on Swiggy or Zomato follow the cancellation and refund policy of that platform.

Cancelling a pickup order

You can cancel until the outlet starts preparing your food. Please call the outlet or message us on WhatsApp as soon as you can.

Because dishes are cooked fresh to order, we cannot cancel once preparation has started.

How payment works today

Payment today

Online payment is not live yet, and you pay at the outlet when you collect your order. So nothing is charged online, and there is nothing to refund if you cancel in time.

If online payment is introduced, this page will be updated first.

If something is wrong with your order

If an item is missing, wrong or not up to our standard, please tell the outlet straight away. Where possible, tell us before you leave, and in any case on the same day. A photo helps.

We will replace the item, or refund or credit the amount for the affected item.

Refund timing

When online payment is available, an approved refund goes back to the original payment method. Banks usually take 5 to 7 working days to show it.

Catering bookings

The advance, the cancellation window and any deduction are set out in your written catering proposal. Please read it before you confirm.

If you need to change the date, guest count or menu, tell us as early as you can so we can plan supplies and staff.

Things outside our control

If we have to cancel because of an outlet closure, power failure or another event we cannot control, we will tell you as soon as possible and refund anything you have paid for that order.

What is not covered

Change of mind after preparation has started, and orders not collected after we tell you they are ready.

How to reach us

Call +91 77020 77999 or message us on WhatsApp. Please have your name and order details ready.

Need to cancel or report a problem?

Have your name and order details ready and we will sort it out.
